invariant: Each recognized consequential fact in an exposable summary maps to exact active original memory versions, and every source fact is represented.
oracle_cases: generated extractive summary maps four facts, including both sides of a dispute, to exact source IDs and versions
lossless phrase-dictionary summary decodes exactly and maps source facts to all original versions
added unsupported fact causes compaction refusal and no memory commit
retracted original version is refused by stored dependency-map verification
identical duplicate factual source text maps to every active original version, including a corrected version 2

lint.command: python -m ruff check src/memory_fabric/summary_dependencies.py src/memory_fabric/compaction.py tests/test_summary_dependencies.py tests/test_lossless_compaction.py

limitations: Fact identity follows the current normalized identifier/content-word/numeric-value extractor; unstructured qualitative claims without identifiers or values are not certified as consequential facts.
This is local contract evidence, not an independent security or model-quality review.
